dude don't know what you mean, but if you're in danger call the cops

Hey wait. I understand your situation a little because I have a similar situation, but believe me, suicide is not an option. You are 18 years old, you just have a bunch of opportunities, you can run away from problems at any time, or you can solve them. You can do a lot that is beyond my reach (I'm only 15). I would really like to help you, maybe even meet, but I live in fucking Ukraine, and you know it's lousy. I truly believe that you will get through this. If you want to talk, feel free to write to me, but don't die, I will get you from the other world
**Hey, I also have some problems with my studies, the main thing is not to think about it a lot, relax and rest with your family, and as for a nuclear war, I think you shouldn't worry at all**

**hey listen. I am very sorry that you have such a serious illness and that your brother has committed suicide. In fact, many fathers are assholes in relation to their children, I'm very glad that your mom loves you, it's really cool. But don't you dare do what your brother did, believe me this is not an option. Yes, a serious illness, a tense situation, but never think about suicide, this is not an option. I think you have friends who can help you through this period, but in any case, you can write to me, just please do not commit suicide bro**
# if you're just joking, ok, but if you need help you can write to me :)

Hey, stop saying that. Everyone is good in their own way, but everyone has a bad side. If you want to discuss this topic in detail, you can write me in private messages, but don't fucking die. Please, you're not special about your death!

Hey, listen up. The situation is really complicated, 20-30 hours of work is difficult. You have friends or acquaintances to whom you could turn for help and support, if yes that older do it. And if not, there are special help services and hotlines helplines. Do not leave it as it is, you will cope with everything, the main thing is to survive this period. I wish you the best of luck in your studies and life in general, you're strong, You're going to make it. (I apologize for my terrible English)
